description: Make a signed link to a static Apple Maps image (PNG): centred on an address or "lat,lng", and/or with pins (each with an optional label, colour and one-character glyph; the map fits the pins when no center is given). Choose zoom, size (up to 640x640), scale, map type (standard, hybrid, satellite, mutedStandard) and light/dark. Returns the URL only — nothing is downloaded; the link can be made to expire. Uses the same Apple Developer key (MapKit JS): APPLE_TEAM_ID, APPLE_KEY_ID, APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY.

annotations.description: Up to 50 pins, drawn in this order.

address.description: Pin location as an address (give point or address).

color.description: Pin colour: a hex code like "FF3B30" or an HTML colour name like "red".

glyphText.description: One letter or digit drawn inside the pin (not shown on "dot" markers).

label.description: What this pin is. The image cannot show text, so a labelled pin gets a letter glyph and the response lists a legend.

markerStyle.description: Marker shape: balloon (default), large or dot.

point.description: Pin location as "latitude,longitude" (give point or address).

center.description: Map centre: an address or "latitude,longitude". Omit to fit the map around the annotations.

colorScheme.description: light (default) or dark; dark applies to standard and mutedStandard only.

expiresInMinutes.description: Make the link stop working after this many minutes (max 30 days). Default: no expiry.

lang.description: Language for names and addresses, as a BCP 47 tag such as en-US, fr-FR or ja-JP (default en-US).

scale.description: Pixel density 1–3 (2 for retina screens; default 1).

showPointsOfInterest.description: Show businesses and landmarks on the map (default true).

zoom.description: Zoom level 3 (continent) to 20 (building); Apple default 12. Needs center.

name: apple_maps_snapshot_url
title: Make a static map image link (Apple Maps)
